title: mcp: the stdio object resources serve labels and descriptions in the workspace default locale, as the object tools now do
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic); the maintainer set who files this epic's cards, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6953983684), from area o3-G's PR #34922 on #34872; the filer did not re-read the code behind it.

## Why

The same object is described to a client in two places. After #34872 the two tools answer in the caller's language; the two resources still answer in the language the author wrote. A client that reads the resource sees English for an app the tools describe in Chinese.

## Evidence

- Per the report: `objectstack://objects` and `objectstack://objects/{name}` (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`, `buildObjectListResource` and `buildObjectSchemaResource`) serve the authored text; PR #34922 localizes `list_objects` and `describe_object` only.

## Scope

- Both resources go through the same `translateMetaList` path the tools use, with the i18n default locale on stdio as #34787 did for datasets. No second translation routine.
- A pin: a translated label in the resource under a workspace default locale, the authored one without.

## Done when

- A resource read and a tool call for the same object return the same labels.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34872 (PR #34922), #34787.
